General web searches did not establish a primary lexical analysis, and the Bailey dictionary PDF could not be inspected through the web reader because it exceeded the reader size limit. No English much connection is inferred. Mixed muc / zīādā also needs a supported immediate donor for its second response. This is an unresolved lexical family, not merely unresolved cross-IA transmission.
